### Problem

A merge into main outside DiluxOne/.github brings the autopilot pull requests it leaves in conflict back in step only within the hour, so a ready pull request sits idle up to an hour for a fix round nobody needs to ask for.

### Scope

The sweep (`autopilot-sweep.yml`) runs for the one repository where a pull request merged, within minutes of the merge, in every repository that runs the organisation's workflows. The hourly run stays.

### Out of scope

Keeping two autopilot pull requests that touch the same files from running at once. Any change to how the fix round resolves a conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given a ready autopilot pull request in a repository other than DiluxOne/.github, when another pull request merges into main and leaves it in conflict, then within 10 minutes the sweep for that repository answers `continue` and its issue gets `autopilot:catchup` and `autopilot:continue`, with no hourly run in between.
C2: Given a ready autopilot pull request only behind main, with no conflict, when another pull request merges, then within 10 minutes the bot updates its branch.
C3: Given a merge into main with no issue closed, when the hour comes, then the hourly sweep still brings the open autopilot pull requests in step.

### Criticality

Normal
